body.label: Target
body.html: Self and up to two willing allies within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Each target moves up to 2 units, ignoring ground difficult terrain, and resists its next 1 unit of forced movement until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Increase one target's movement by 1 unit.
Each target suppresses one ordinary Slowed Condition during the movement.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Elemental
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 3 Mana to enter Elemental Full Manifestation (FM-2E). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
